ridge_objective: weighted mean logistic negative log-likelihood + ||beta||^2/(2C); intercept unpenalized
tuning_ties: smaller signature size, then smaller C (stronger regularization)
sample_weighting: equal total weight per cohort and equal case/control weight within cohort
feature_standardization: unweighted mean and population SD estimated from the current training partition only
primary_comparator: M_ONLY: disease-magnitude ranking with identical weighted ridge-logistic classifier
secondary_comparator: COHORT_ADJ: absolute weighted cohort-adjusted disease t-statistic with identical weighted ridge-logistic classifier
calibration: logistic recalibration fitted to training-cohort cross-fitted predictions only; slope constrained nonnegative; applied frozen to outer held-out cohort
primary_estimand: outer-cohort AUROC difference PAFS minus M_ONLY
primary_uncertainty: 2000-replicate participant-cluster bootstrap within each outer held-out development cohort
descriptive_pooling: DerSimonian-Laird random-effects pooling of the six outer-cohort AUROC differences
feature_stability: pairwise Jaccard and Kuncheva indices across outer-training rankings at m = 5,10,20,50,100

elasticnet_stage1b_prespecified.status: not run in Stage 1A; remains required before external validation

notes: Stage 1A may use disease labels from development cohorts only. No external expression matrix may be loaded or evaluated. ElasticNet is frozen as Stage 1B and must be completed before unlocking external validation.
